description: This file is a script for managing development workflows in the Notesnook project, including watching source files, rebuilding, bundling, and restarting processes.

methods.name: spawnAndWaitUntil
methods.description: Spawns a process and resolves when a predicate on its output is true.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with environment variables.

methods.name: execAsync
methods.description: Spawns a process asynchronously, optionally restartable, and handles its exit.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: killProcesses
methods.description: Kills a list of processes using tree-kill.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup by killing processes and removing build directory.

methods.name: isBundleSame
methods.description: Checks if the current bundle files are identical to the previous build using SHA-256 hash.
